summary_paragraph: A 50-year-old male with a history of psoriatic arthritis on chronic steroids was admitted for observation following his second rituximab infusion, due to a prior episode of adrenal crisis with hypotension, hallucinations, and acute kidney injury after the first dose. He received the infusion during the day with close monitoring and experienced mild symptoms including body heaviness and blurry vision, but remained hemodynamically stable without significant hypotension or neurological changes. His kidney function remained normal, and blood glucose was managed with his home insulin regimen. He was monitored overnight, remained asymptomatic, and was discharged the following day in stable condition with no medication changes and instructions to follow up with rheumatology in six weeks.
problems: Diabetes mellitus without mention of complication, type II or unspecified type, not stated as uncontrolled
Adrenal cortical steroids causing adverse effects in therapeutic use
Unspecified hereditary and idiopathic peripheral neuropathy
